tldr.text: This investigation of variation in captive animals' welfare by focusing on caged carnivores shows that it stems from constraints imposed on the natural behaviour of susceptible animals, with wide-ranging lifestyles in the wild predicting stereotypy and the extent of infant mortality in captivity.
